exceptions.justification: CVE-2026-118764 is a pattern-amplification denial of service (CWE-405); minimatch's vulnerable input is its pattern argument. Redocly 1.34.20 has one call site, minimatch(url, pattern), where the tested URL comes from an external HTTP $ref and the pattern comes only from resolve.http.headers[].matches in a local Redocly config. The current frontend has no Redocly config; every one of the 273 $ref values in its committed OpenAPI snapshot is an internal JSON pointer (#/...), so no external HTTP $ref is resolved, and even an external $ref would supply only the tested URL, never the pattern; and openapi-typescript's CLI falls back to a minimal config with no HTTP match patterns. Thus the repository build has no untrusted path to the vulnerable pattern. These three packages are dev-only and absent from the production dist bundle.
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove this exception as soon as the audited dependency tree no longer reports this advisory at the registered package and node path, including when upstream packages adopt a fixed minimatch. The gate fails on expiry, package or path drift, severity increases, or any additional finding. The 30-day review window ends 2026-11-30. Because the gate admits exactly one exception, removing it also means restoring the plain `npm audit --audit-level=low` frontend step in .github/workflows/ci.yml and deleting scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs, its tests and fixtures, and this register.
